text:
Marta R: Heads up — since ~09:30 we started seeing spikes in unassigned inbound leads. Leads waiting for enrichment >30s are not entering round-robin. :eyes:
Jon S: Saw that, looks like the HubSpot enrichment webhook timed out and the RR job skipped a bunch of records.
HubSpot Bot: Workflow 'lead-enrich' failed for 43 leads — HTTP 504 from enrichment-service
Samir: Can we flip to a fallback default owner while we triage? Minimal blast radius please.
Marta R: Yes. Proposal: set default owner to `marketing-queue` after 45s, and emit a metric for visibility. Thoughts?
Ana K: +1. 45s seems reasonable. Also add a debounce so we don't reassign when enrichment finishes after the timeout.
Leo P: Ops, can you temporarily add a `default-owner` rule in HS? Tagging @ops.
Jon S: Revops playbook needs a quick patch — I can push to the `RR` workflow to: 1) set `default_owner=marketing-queue` if no owner after 45s, 2) emit `lead.unowned.count`, 3) set `enrichment_debounce=30s`.
Ops-bot: Deploy job queued for `hubspot-workflows/quickpatch` — ETA ~8m
Samir: Also, let's not change SF sync mapping. We want default owner to be soft (owner_type=queue) so handoff to SDRs still works.
Marta R: Agreed. Also add an audit tag `fallback_assigned=true` so we can filter handoffs later.
Ana K: Can we add an alert: if >10 leads per 5m go to default owner, page me and Jon?
Jon S: Yes. I'll add a Grafana alert: `sum(rate(lead_unowned_total[5m])) > 10` -> page @AnaK + @JonS.
HubSpot Bot: Webhook patch applied to workflow `RoundRobinAssign` — success
Ops-bot: Quick deploy finished. Runbook note: rollback = remove `default_owner` flag from workflow + clear audit tag.
Samir: Running a smoke test with a synthetic lead (email test+rr1@example.com).
Marta R: Test lead created and hit default owner — looks good. :white_check_mark:
Ana K: I'll update the inbound playbook (docs) and add sample queries + pager contacts.
Leo P: Let's add a 1-week retrospective check: if fallback fire count >100 in 7d, escalate to eng-ml to investigate enrichment latency.
Jon S: Added retrospective check and task in the playbook draft.
Marta R: Thanks everyone. Follow-ups: Jon to create alert and PR, Ana to update docs, Ops to monitor rollout for 2h. I'll ping product if this affects SLAs.
Jon S: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/marketing-playbooks/pull/312
Ana K: Docs updated: shortlink https://redwood.link/handoff-fallback
Marta R: Closing thread after 2h if stable. :lock:
